expectations.text: Identifies 'or' as an option indicator — CSV and PDF are two separate format stories
expectations.evidence: The output explicitly states "'CSV or PDF' is two independent output formats — they require different libraries, different rendering logic, and different user value" and notes "the story has at least two 'or' splits". CSV and PDF are placed in separate stories (Stories 1-2 for CSV, Story 3 for PDF).

expectations.text: Identifies 'all users' as an overly broad scope and proposes starting with a specific segment (e.g. admins)
expectations.evidence: The output explicitly calls out "'All users' hides role differences" and explains different user types (free, premium, admin, guest) have different data access, volumes, and entitlements. Story 4 specifically targets admins: "As an admin, I can export any user's data to CSV".

expectations.text: Applies BOTH techniques: Narrow Customer Segment AND Simplify Outputs — not just one of the two
expectations.evidence: Both techniques are applied: (1) Narrow Customer Segment — stories target 'regular user' and 'admin' separately rather than 'all users'; (2) Simplify Outputs — CSV and PDF are split into separate stories (Stories 1-2 for CSV, Story 3 for PDF). The split is explicitly described as 'along two axes: format first, then user type / data scope'.

expectations.text: Proposes CSV before PDF — the first story does not include PDF
expectations.evidence: Story 1 is 'As a regular user, I can export my own profile data to CSV', Story 2 is 'As a regular user, I can export my transaction/activity history to CSV', and only Story 3 introduces PDF. The summary table confirms PDF first appears at priority 3.

expectations.text: The first story targets a narrow segment (admins, power users) rather than 'all users'
expectations.evidence: Story 1 targets 'a regular user' (not 'all users'): "As a regular user, I can export my own profile data to CSV". The recommendation explicitly says "Start with Story 1" which is scoped to a single user type accessing only their own data.
